name: Beat the Beast: Dragon's Wrath
review:
A 3x5, 9-line fantasy fight against a dragon. Majestic wilds and roaming wilds that move around the reels carry the base game, along with a wild multiplier that can lift a modest line into something better.

The bonus gives free spins, and retriggers unlock the dragon's hoard, so keeping the round going is what you're hoping for. Very high volatility, 11,111x cap, 96.18% RTP. Compact, but with real bite.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
